title: Gruyere Full Coverage Proof: All Known Vulnerabilities Found
goal: After backlog-348 (authenticated scanning) and backlog-349 (AI signals) are complete, run a complete assessment against Google Gruyere and prove that the system finds all documented vulnerability categories: Reflected XSS, Stored XSS, File Upload XSS, CSRF, XSSI, Path Traversal, Client-State Manipulation, Information Disclosure. This is the acceptance test for the full AI adaptive pentest chain.
generation_reason: Current coverage is ~30% (unauthenticated only). Full proof requires auth chain (348) and AI signals (349) to be complete.
success_criteria: Reflected XSS: found via xss-extended on snippets.gtl?uid= parameter.
Stored XSS: found via xss-extended or auth-flow on authenticated snippet submission.
CSRF: confirmed via ZAP or dedicated CSRF check on authenticated forms.
Path Traversal: found on authenticated file/snippet endpoints.
Client-State Manipulation: found via client-state runner with auth session.
Coverage Truth shows >= 80% applicable surfaces as tested or partially_tested.
out_of_scope: Bypassing approval gates, scope/ROE boundaries, credential protections, or kill-switch behavior.
Running live public target scans without explicit operator authorization.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement until this package is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
